prompt:

Constraints: No text, letters, writing, signs, flags, coats of arms, maps, logos, watermark, borders, stamps or UI. No invented landmarks or unrelated scenery.
inspection: Central streamlined stepped tower and broad symmetrical cantilever wings identify Fiat Tagliero amid modernist streetscape. No readable building words. Architecture is painterly and simplified, not a measured reconstruction.
